summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the shared venv. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, black and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only; line lengths were checked to be within 88 columns. An explicit Node isinstance guard was added so None is not treated as a graph wildcard. One non-node test sits outside the parametrized test.
